notes.title: Serial Cleaner now on Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi there!

Our new game called Serial Cleaner is now on Early Access! 

It’s a story-driven, fast-paced stealth/action game, characterized by a 1970’s theme and aesthetics, in which the player needs to figure out how to pick the location clean of evidence, while not getting caught. The protagonist is a professional cleaner, which means he takes care of cleaning up murder scenes by disposing bodies, covering up blood stains and hiding murder weapons and other incriminating evidence. 

You can see Early Access trailer below

https://youtu.be/yOLqB-bTVHk

Serial Cleaner takes a humoristic, slightly macabre approach to its subject matter, and doesn't treat itself too seriously. Just take a look at the protagonist. He is a 30-ish man with a sharp sense of style and an iconic 70s look, complete with a mustache, large sunglasses, and tight pants.

We hope you will enjoy it!
iFun4all Team
